scheme_name: Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
description:
The Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools scheme is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at supporting the welfare of construction workers.

This scheme is specifically designed for workers who are registered under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The scheme was launched on 1st April 2008.

It is part of a broader effort to enhance the livelihoods of construction workers in the state of Odisha.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the purchase of essential tools required for construction work.

The scheme aims to empower construction workers by enabling them to acquire the necessary tools to enhance their productivity.

The measurable target of this scheme is to assist at least 10,000 construction workers annually.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is capped at INR 10,000.

This amount is intended to cover the costs associated with purchasing tools that are essential for construction activities.

Eligible beneficiaries must be registered construction workers under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

To qualify for this scheme, workers must have a valid registration number issued by the Board.

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility.

Income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the applicant's family income should not exceed INR 1,50,000 per annum.

Workers must also provide proof of their employment in the construction sector.

The application process involves several steps that need to be followed meticulously.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the local office of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Board.

Next, the applicant must fill out the form with accurate details including personal information and registration number.

The applicant must then gather the required documents which include proof of identity, proof of registration, and proof of income.

Once the form is completed and documents are gathered, the applicant must submit the application to the local office of the Board.

The application must be submitted within the stipulated time frame which is typically announced by the Board.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the officials of the Board.

The review process generally takes about 30 days.

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly into the bank account of the applicant.

The disbursement is usually done within 15 days of approval.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Odisha.

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Board at their official office located in Bhubaneswar.

The contact number for the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is 0674-2390014.

The email address for inquiries is obocwboard@gmail.com.

This scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare measures aimed at improving the living standards of construction workers in Odisha.

As of the latest reports, over 50,000 construction workers have benefited from this scheme since its inception.

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the financial burden on workers who need to purchase tools for their trade.

The financial assistance helps workers to invest in quality tools which can enhance their efficiency and safety at work.

The initiative also aims to promote self-employment among construction workers.

By providing the necessary tools, the scheme encourages workers to take on more projects and improve their income.

The Government of Odisha continuously monitors the implementation of this scheme to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries.

Regular workshops and awareness programs are conducted to educate workers about the scheme and its benefits.

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have reported increased productivity after acquiring tools through the grant.

In addition to this scheme, the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers various other welfare measures.

These include health insurance, financial assistance for education, and housing benefits.

The comprehensive approach of the Board aims to create a supportive ecosystem for construction workers.

The scheme is a testament to the Government of Odisha's commitment to the welfare of its workers.

It reflects the broader national policy of enhancing the livelihoods of informal sector workers.

The Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools scheme is a crucial step towards recognizing the contribution of construction workers to the economy.

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also empowers workers by giving them the tools they need to succeed.

The Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is dedicated to improving the lives of construction workers through various initiatives.

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of the workforce.

Future enhancements may include increasing the grant amount or expanding eligibility criteria to include more workers.

The Government of Odisha remains committed to ensuring that all construction workers have access to the tools and resources they need to thrive.

The scheme is an essential part of the state's strategy to uplift marginalized communities within the construction sector.

By investing in the tools of trade, the government is investing in the future of construction workers in Odisha.
